moisture_pct.quote: In the case of Neufchatel cheeses, the variability between brands in their moisture (from 61.24 to 65.59%) and fat contents (from 20.69 to 25.17%) was even greater than what was observed for the full-fat cream cheeses.

fat_pct.quote: In the case of Neufchatel cheeses, the variability between brands in their moisture (from 61.24 to 65.59%) and fat contents (from 20.69 to 25.17%) was even greater than what was observed for the full-fat cream cheeses.

ph.quote: The pH values of Neufchatel cheeses were similar to those of full-fat cream cheeses, with values between 4.62 and 5.16.

ammonia.reason: Fresh low pH with no surface flora deamination/urease activity.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasteurized cow milk fresh curd lacks p-cresol/indole barnyard notes.

bitter.reason: Very limited rennet/plasmin proteolysis to hydrophobic bitter peptides.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti; no C7/C9 methyl ketones in fresh cheese.

browning.reason: High moisture dilute protein/lactose limits Maillard on heating.

buttery.reason: Mesophilic Lactococcus citrate metabolism yields diacetyl/acetoin in fresh acid curd.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Minimal lipolysis in unripened curd gives very low free butanoic/hexanoic acids.

creaminess.reason: Homogenized milkfat plus whey proteins/gums form smooth creamy emulsion.

crumbliness.reason: High-moisture acid gel deforms plastically rather than fracturing.

firmness.reason: High moisture ~63% acid gel with homogenized fat gives soft spreadable body.

floral_honey.reason: Minimal aromatic amino acid catabolism to phenylacetaldehyde/phenylethanol.

fruity.reason: Very short storage limits esterase formation of ethyl butanoate/hexanoate.

goaty.reason: Cow milk fat lacks goaty branched C8 acids like 4-ethyloctanoic acid.

malty_nutty.reason: No ripening proteolysis/Strecker aldehydes; only faint milky notes.

melt.reason: Acid-decalcified low-pH casein softens without flowing on heating.

oil_off.reason: Low homogenized fat with stabilizers keeps emulsion, little free oil.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked make; no guaiacol/syringol from smoke.

sour_vinegar.reason: Mesophilic starter ferments lactose to lactic acid to pH ~4.8, sharp lactic tang.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata alignment; acid network lacks extensible para-casein.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Gentle pasteurization, no cooked curd; trace H2S from starter only.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose/galactose and diacetyl impart mild milky sweetness.

umami.reason: Low free glutamate due to minimal proteolysis in unripened gel.
